capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Monkey D. Luffy, commonly known as "Straw Hat Luffy" or simply "Straw Hat", is the founder and captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. [Chapter 455] [Chapter 606] He pursues the legendary treasure of the late Gol D. [Chapter 585] [Chapter 1060] He believes that being the Pirate King means having the most freedom in the world. [Chapter 507] Born on Dawn Island, Luffy is the son of Revolutionary leader Monkey D.

capability_summary.offense: Gear 5 was created during the climax of the Raid on Onigashima, as a result of Luffy awakening his Devil Fruit for the first time since the Void Century. [Chapter 1044] After awakening, Luffy gains increased physical power and even greater freedom while demonstrating many new abilities, such as being able to freely manipulate the shape and size of his body; instead of focusing more on hardening himself using Armament Haki, he takes on a more cartoonish fighting style, as well as being able to grant the environment around him the same properties as rubber, which allowed him to deflect a Bolo Breath by bouncing it back at Kaidou, as well as being able to stretch objects he touches like rubber, including living things and even lightning. As pointed out by Kaidou, Luffy's power now has the characteristics of both Paramecia and Zoan. [Chapter 1045]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Luffy is an immensely skilled user of Armament Haki, having learned it from Silvers Rayleigh during the two-year timeskip. Since then, he uses it in combat in the New World to increase his offense and defense, in addition to being able to touch and damage Logia users, such as Caesar Clown, [Chapter 670] and those with features similar to them, like Charlotte Katakuri, a Special Paramecia user. [Chapter 884] Armament Haki has been an exceptional benefit to Luffy in the New World, as he is capable of fighting against and damaging much stronger opponents that he could not before. It is most noted as he uses Gear 4, which relies on using Armament Haki, as the compressed Haki forms a coating that resembles flames.
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Luffy possesses tremendous speed, agility, and reflexes. While knocked on his back, he was quickly able to escape from a point-blank explosion during his fight with Foxy, jumping onto a nearby mast before he was caught up in the blast. When he fought Blueno and Rob Lucci on Enies Lobby, Luffy was able to keep up with their incredibly fast Soru movements even without using the massive speed boost of his Gear 2 form.
capability_summary.leadership: Luffy possesses a notable ability to recruit allies to his side everywhere he goes, which Dracule Mihawk describes as the most dangerous ability in the world. Luffy is capable of making friends rather quickly, and people typically have to do little for Luffy to consider them friends, such as Rebecca, who earned Luffy's friendship by buying him food. [Chapter 720] Although Luffy does not fancy himself a hero, he will do anything to help his friends, which can earn him the respect of people around him, as seen with the Whitebeard Pirates being impressed with his desire to save Ace on Marineford. [Chapter 562] Luffy is not afraid to take audacious actions to help himself and his friends, and this fearlessness is another key to gaining allies. demonstrated_abilities.name: Devil Fruit
demonstrated_abilities.description: When he was 7 years old, Luffy unwittingly ate the Gomu Gomu no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit, after finding it in a chest owned by the Red Hair Pirates. It gives his body the properties of rubber, allowing him to stretch, bounce, bend, twist, and inflate any part of his body. [Chapter 1] Initially, Luffy was unable to control his stretching, [Chapter 585] but was able to master it after ten years of training on Dawn Island, and further master it during the two years he spent training with Silvers Rayleigh on Rusukaina. During the Wano Country Arc, it was revealed that it is actually a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit, the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika, which allows the user to become an incarnation of Nika, an ever-playful Sun God known for liberating slaves and bringing smiles to people's faces.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Nightmare Luffy
demonstrated_abilities.description: Before his fight against Gecko Moria and Oars during the Thriller Bark Arc, the Rolling Pirates helped Luffy become temporarily stronger by infusing him with the power of one hundred shadows that were separated from their owners by Moria's use of the Kage Kage no Mi. demonstrated_abilities.name: Armament Haki
demonstrated_abilities.description: Zoro is an extremely skilled user of Armament Haki. [Chapter 668] It became his main expertise, having learned it from Dracule Mihawk, mastering both hardening and imbuement during the two-year timeskip, turning them black. [Chapter 779] Despite this, hardening is often used during serious battles, as well as using this Armament Haki to harm Logia users, as seen when he imbued it into a flying slash, wounding Monet. At Dressrosa, against Pica, Zoro hardened all three of his swords, cutting apart the mountain-sized stone giant, surprising the members of the Nine Red Scabbards, Kin'emon and Kanjuro. He later cut through the Elite Officer, who had hardened himself using Armament Haki, similar to Vergo, proving that his Armament Haki mastery was superior to his.

demonstrated_abilities.description: Zoro possesses immense physical strength [Chapter 194] and frequently spends his time at sea lifting incredibly large and heavy weights to keep growing stronger. [Chapter 490] Zoro's strength plays a large role in his abilities as a swordsman, as his strikes possess a great amount of power and range in their cutting ability. Thanks to his strength, Zoro is capable of clashing equally with superhumanly large and powerful opponents and can send normal-sized opponents flying away with ease. [Chapter 29] Although he initially had trouble cutting Mr. 1's skin due to the latter's Devil Fruit, Zoro's strikes had enough power to knock the powerful martial artist to the ground. [Chapter 194] Zoro could clash with the likes of Kaku, a superhuman assassin whose strength and weight were both dramatically increased by his Zoan powers, and even managed to overpower him after flexing his biceps and…
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Physical Abilities / Strength' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Swordsmanship
demonstrated_abilities.description: Zoro is an extremely skilled and talented swordsman; training at the Isshin Dojo in Shimotsuki Village from childhood, he was able to consistently defeat adult swordsmen in duels, while Kuina being the one person he could not beat. After reaching adulthood, he became a great master swordsman famous for wielding three swords in battle. [Chapter 5] Since Zoro's goal is to become the World's Strongest Swordsman, [Chapter 5] he devoted himself to swordsmanship, becoming known across the East Blue. When confronting Dracule Mihawk, the current World's Strongest Swordsman, he was utterly outclassed by the Warlord even just using his Kogatana. [Chapter 51] However, Mihawk was impressed by Zoro's conviction and let him live, believing he could reach the top and challenge him.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Foxfire Style
demonstrated_abilities.description: Originally, Zoro first developed an interest in the Foxfire Style, the unique sword style of Kin'emon, the Nine Red Scabbards' Leader, when he first saw Kin'emon use it against Smiley at Punk Hazard. [Chapter 672] Later during the battle against Kaidou and Big Mom at Onigashima, it was revealed that Zoro "stole" this technique. As such, he can cut through flames, as shown when he bisected the Sun Homie, Prometheus, hurting him. Despite being his first time using it, Zoro has proven himself quite adaptable in using it, slicing through Kaidou's Bolo Breath, then incorporating it into his sword styles without much difference between them. [Chapter 1002] [Chapter 1008] Zoro then sliced through King's strongest technique, Omori Karyudon, and then the lunarian himself, thus defeating him. [Chapter 1035]
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship / Foxfire Style' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Nine Sword Style
demonstrated_abilities.description: Nine Sword Style is the most extreme application of Zoro's spirit projection abilities. With sufficient anger, a dark aura surrounds him and somehow managed to create a solid illusion of himself with multiple heads and arms that can actually slice though even the strongest of opponents, giving him the essence of nine swords. Despite its seemingly purely spiritual nature, Zoro's attack power increases threefold, letting him disperse Kaku's Rankyaku "Amane Dachi", his strongest Rankyaku and cut him several times in an instant. [Chapter 417] This form is used very rarely in canon, having been shown first against Kaku on Enies Lobby and later against PX-4 at the Sabaody Archipelago. [Chapter 510] It was used for the first time after the timeskip against Kaidou alongside Armament Haki, which was powerful enough to inflict a permanent scar on him.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship / Nine Sword Style' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: One Sword Style
demonstrated_abilities.description: One Sword Style is a sword fighting style that Zoro began to perfect and then master. Like the previous styles, Zoro has exceptional skill in One Sword Style and has repeatedly used this style to perform finishing moves against a vast range of enemies. Similar to Two Sword Style, flying slashes and various unsheathing and re-sheathing techniques are used in this style, mainly to defeat or injure powerful opponents with a single strike.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship / One Sword Style' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Three Sword Style
demonstrated_abilities.description: Three Sword Style is Zoro's main style of sword fighting. Unusual for a human, he wields three swords simultaneously, holding one in each hand and one in his mouth. Many of Zoro's Three Sword Style attacks use all three of the blades to strike opponents, cutting them numerous times or cutting multiple opponents at the same time. [Chapter 33] When performing flying slashes with Three Sword Style, Zoro can create whirlwind-like attacks that have shown the ability to catch and strike dozens of opponents at once.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship / Three Sword Style' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: King of Hell Three Sword Style
demonstrated_abilities.description: During the Wano Country Arc, Zoro developed the Armament Haki and Supreme King Haki; significantly increasing his techniques' power and range more than either of his prior styles, which could wound and defeat one of the last surviving Lunarians, King, whereas before he shrugged off his strongest techniques thus far. However, because using the King of Hell Three Style Sword is based on Zoro allowing Enma to drain his Haki reserves, he is not able to maintain this for that long before running out of Haki and would need time to recover it. [Chapter 1035]
demonstrated_abilities.source_section: Swordsmanship / Three Sword Style / King of Hell Three Sword Style
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship / Three Sword Style / King of Hell Three Sword Style' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Two Sword Style
demonstrated_abilities.description: Two Sword Style is Zoro's original fighting style in his childhood before he started practicing Three Sword Style. Like Three Sword Style, Zoro has immense mastery of this style of sword fighting, dual-wielding two of his swords in battle with great power and skill, even incorporating unsheathing and re-sheathing techniques as well as flying slashes. On Thriller Bark, before he acquired Shusui as a replacement for the destroyed Yubashiri, Zoro could dual wield both Wado Ichimonji and Sandai Kitetsu with incredible power and precision, able to fight equivalently with Ryuma, an extremely powerful samurai zombie imbued with Brook's swordsmanship skills through the Kage Kage no Mi for a majority of their battle before switching to use One Sword Style to finish off the undead warrior.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Swordsmanship / Two Sword Style' of the inspected ability profile.

weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: Currently, Zoro is known to have owned seven swords, all of them katanas and has briefly borrowed multiple other swords and weapons when necessary. Due to his Three Sword Style, he usually owns three swords at a time.

weapons_and_equipment.name: Current Swords
weapons_and_equipment.description: #Wado Ichimonji: One of the 21 Great Grade Famous Blades. [Chapter 97] Forged by the legendary Wano swordsmith Shimotsuki Kouzaburou and previously owned by his granddaughter and Zoro's friend Kuina; given to Zoro 11 years ago by Kuina's father, Koushirou, after her untimely death. The only one of Zoro's swords that did not shatter when Zoro first clashed with Mihawk's Supreme Grade sword, Yoru. #Sandai Kitetsu: A Grade Famous Blade; it is said to be "cursed" and will bring great misfortune upon its owner. Forged by the great Wano swordsmith Kouzuki Sukiyaki and given to Zoro two years ago in Loguetown by the arms dealer Ipponmatsu. #Enma: One of the 21 Great Grade Famous Blades.

weapons_and_equipment.name: Former Swords
weapons_and_equipment.description: These swords were once owned by Zoro, but were either destroyed or removed from his possession. #Two unnamed katanas that were given to him as a child from Shimotsuki Kouzaburou. [Chapter 1033] They were used alongside Wado Ichimonji for an unknown period of time until they were shattered during Zoro's first duel with Dracule Mihawk. #Yubashiri: One of the 50 Skillful Grade Famous Blades. Formerly an heirloom of Ipponmatsu's family, he gave it to Zoro after witnessing the swordsman's great fortune. While handcuffed to Usopp on Enies Lobby, Zoro had him hold Yubashiri while he held his crewmate like a sword hilt, calling this situational weapon "Hana Arashi". [Chapter 410] It was then destroyed by Shu, who rusted it to the point of crumbling on Enies Lobby, [Chapter 426] and was put to rest at the Rumbar Pirates' gravesite on Thriller Bark. #Shusui: One of the 21 Great Grade Famous…

weapons_and_equipment.name: Situational Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: These weapons were used by Zoro for extremely brief periods, usually to allow him to use Three Sword Style when he lacked one or two of his swords. #Johnny's and Yosaku's Nakiri Swords, which were borrowed by Zoro during his fight against Hatchan in Arlong Park while he only possessed Wado Ichimonji. He returned the swords to them after the fight concluded. #A pair of cutlasses from Wapol's vassals on Drum Island. He discarded the weapons after defeating all of the men. [Chapter 141] #A Marine cutlass to replace Yubashiri in the remainder of the battle on Enies Lobby, which was also destroyed by Shu. #A tanto meant for him to perform seppuku, which he instead used to cut down Toyama Tsujigiro. #A scythe wielded by Kamazo, which Zoro seized after it pierced him and used in place of the missing Shusui to cut down Kamazo.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: "Cat Burglar" Nami is the navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. She is the third member of the crew and the second to join, doing so during the Orange Town Arc. [Chapter 8] She is the adoptive sister of Nojiko after the two were orphaned and taken in by Bell-mère. She was formerly a member of the Arlong Pirates who initially joined the Straw Hats to rob them in order to buy back her village from Arlong, and served as a supporting antagonist during the Baratie Arc.

These harsh and sometimes brutal experiences granted Nami a very high level of physical capabilities. In the Water 7 Arc, she demonstrated exceptional agility and incredible leg strength, being able to jump the wide distances between rooftops in Water 7.

capability_summary.leadership: Nami is a very convincing person, so much so that she has shown herself to be quite the negotiator in her own right. She has shown to be able to negotiate on behalf of most of the Straw Hats, although most of the negotiations are charged with financials or anything else that would be for her own benefits. Although she mostly handles the financial negotiations, she is also able to negotiate in other aspects, especially when the Straw Hats do not have much to bargain with, such as making some relationships with others and also keeping the Straw Hats cool during negotiations.

With the Sorcery Clima-Tact now a sentient weapon, this further enhances its abilities, with Zeus being able to change the Clima-Tact into more combat-oriented forms to help aid Nami and temporarily transfer his consciousness to the clouds that Nami summons, which not only allows him to take on a similar appearance to his former cloud form but also enables him to take control of Nami's attacks, making them harder to avoid. This power allowed Nami to produce lightning destructive enough to finally defeat Ulti, the immensely durable Tobiroppo, in one strike (Raitei). [Chapter 1016] This attack was even capable of inflicting damage and stunning the Seraphim S-Shark, [Chapter 1077] burn the…
capability_summary.stealth_infiltration_assassination: Apart from her navigational skills, Nami has also proven herself to be an excellent thief and a master pickpocket. She is able to take small items, such as keys, without her victims noticing, a skill she honed from a young age. For example, while Wapol was chasing her inside Drum Castle, she managed to steal the arsenal key from his belt without him noticing, hoping it was the key to some treasure vault. [Chapter 150] One of her most notable thieving feats was shown just before she left her village.
capability_summary.support_control: Nami is a highly skilled navigator and an extremely talented cartographer. Arlong considered her skills on par with the fish-men's "superiority", since they were superior to any fish-man's. When Luffy destroyed her room at Arlong Park, both bathymetric and geographic maps were seen, proving that Nami has a wide variety of cartographic skills. [Chapter 92] She is capable of formulating advanced equations in mere minutes to predict a precise course of action, although she usually needs to write the equations down on a physical medium when formulating them.

demonstrated_abilities.description: Nami's fighting style focuses mainly on using the Clima-Tact to manipulate the weather of her surroundings, also known as the "Art of Weather". demonstrated_abilities.name: Clima-Tact
demonstrated_abilities.description: Nami first gained the ability to manipulate the weather when Usopp gave her the Clima-Tact. The flaw with his invention, however, was that it was primarily for party tricks. [Chapter 191] Regardless of this conflict, due to her expertise, she was able to combine several of its functions in order to pull off dangerous and useful techniques, like creating a mirage of herself, (Mirage Tempo) in order to distract her opponent, [Chapter 191] and a powerful lightning cloud (Thunderbolt Tempo), which was used on Miss Doublefinger, [Chapter 192] who thought she was a magician.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Art of Weather / Clima-Tact' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Perfect Clima-Tact
demonstrated_abilities.description: After the Skypiea Arc, Usopp improved the Clima-Tact with Dials, creating the Perfect Clima-Tact. This improvement gave her much greater power over the weather, allowing her to easily pull off stronger and newer versions of the tricks she could do with the Clima-Tact, like creating duplicates of herself using mist (Mirage Tempo: Fata Morgana). This weapon was also powerful enough to allow her to wipe out hordes of Marines with Thunderbolt Tempo and defeat CP9's Kalifa with Thunder Lance Tempo.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Art of Weather / Perfect Clima-Tact' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Sorcery Clima-Tact
demonstrated_abilities.description: After the timeskip, her abilities are greatly enhanced, being able to easily destroy a bar and a submarine (and harm the occupants of both) with lightning blasts that can be compared to an attack by Enel. At the stand-off between Neptune's soldiers and Usopp and Brook, she wielded the upgraded version of the Clima-Tact with the disappearance of the balls, which she now calls the Sorcery Clima-Tact. When the Straw Hats arrived at Gyoncorde Plaza, Nami's "Mirage Tempo" was shown to have improved to the point of making her appear completely invisible, and she was also able to shoot a powerful gust of wind she named Gust Sword to easily dispatch a fish-man.

[Chapter 598] With his skills used in conjunction with unique ammunition, such as the Firebird Star, Usopp can deal devastating damage in long-range combat.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Arachnology
demonstrated_abilities.description: Usopp used to make spiders fight when he was younger and knows how to handle them without being bitten by their fangs or being poisoned in the process. [Chapter 230]

demonstrated_abilities.name: Observation Haki
demonstrated_abilities.description: Usopp had awakened his Observation Haki during the latter half of the Dressrosa revolt, as he was able to see auras of Luffy, Law, and Sugar, who were in the royal palace, from the old King's Plateau near the Corrida Colosseum. With this, he was able to pinpoint Sugar's location and snipe her down from such a distance. [Chapter 758] While on Elbaph, Usopp's Observation Haki had improved to the point he was able to immediately sense that Luffy was being gravely injured from afar. [Chapter 1189] However, he still has no mastery over the ability as he senses it as a mere hunch. Non-canonically, in One Piece Film: Red, he also demonstrated exceptional Observation Haki, to the point of being able to use to communicate with his father from afar.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Observation Haki' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Physical Abilities
demonstrated_abilities.description: While not on the same level as the rest of his crew when it comes to pure physical might, Usopp has learned to compensate for his weaknesses by focusing on his own strengths. Usopp has considerable strength; even at his weakest in the East Blue, he can use a work hammer as an improvised weapon, able to send a Fishman flying. He can also carry a full-grown man like Zoro while running at full speed.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Physical Abilities' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Tactical Skills
demonstrated_abilities.description: Being more reliant on intellect than the rest of his crewmates, Usopp is also a highly analytical tactician with quick thinking and incredible ingenuity in battle, able to use deception and cunning strategies to fight and defeat enemies who are physically more powerful than him. In his battle against Chew, a fish-man and an officer of the Arlong Pirates, Usopp threw a bottle of rum at him, catching him off guard before Usopp destroyed the bottle and ignited the alcohol with a Kaen Boshi, setting him aflame before exploiting the chance to hit him hard with his hammer multiple times to defeat him. While aboard the Puffing Tom, Usopp used a smokescreen to catch the CP9 off guard, allowing him to quickly grab Robin to escape, although the plan ultimately failed due to Blueno's Devil Fruit abilities and Robin's traumatic fear of the Buster Call.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Tactical Skills' of the inspected ability profile.

Its range is enormous, and Usopp can use it to strike individual targets quite accurately from seemingly impossible distances over a mile.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Weapons / Kabuto' of the inspected ability profile.

During the Fish-Man Island Arc, he also manages to save the crew and the Thousand Sunny from being crushed by boulders by using Pop Greens to grow seaweed-like plants to trap the boulders, and when they encountered the New Fish-Man Pirates in the Ryugu Palace, he used a giant flower with a terrible smell to deter them. weapons_and_equipment.description: Due to his engineering expertise, Usopp is able to utilize the available technology and tools to construct and upgrade weapons. capability_summary.offense: Robin ate the Hana Hana no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows her to sprout duplicates of any of her body parts from any surface within range. She can sprout her duplicate body parts from her own body, inanimate surfaces, and even from other people's bodies. She can even sprout duplicate body parts on top of other duplicate body parts.
capability_summary.defense_durability: While not at the same superhuman level as Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, and Jinbe, Robin has exceptional physical prowess due to spending her entire childhood and young adult life constantly on the run from various enemies, such as the Marines and the World Government. Because of her harsh experiences, Robin became physically strong and extremely agile. She has also fought without the use of her Devil Fruit powers, easily defeating Nefertari Vivi with a single strike to the midsection.

capability_summary.tactics: Robin is a brilliant strategist due to her genius intellect: she is extremely skilled in using cunning deception and trickery to gain a strategic advantage over enemies who are more powerful than herself. In the Thriller Bark Arc, she is able to exploit the zombies' complete obedience to their masters, tricking Hogback into giving orders to the two zombies with Zoro and Sanji's shadows to jump off the Thriller Bark mansion, effectively luring them away from Hogback without using physical force. Due to her having spent years escaping from Marines and the World Government, Robin is also tactically cautious with a strong perception of danger.

At Water 7, she admits to Chopper that these habits are from her childhood.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: "Iron Man" Franky is the shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates and one of the Senior Officers of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. He is the crew's eighth member and the seventh to join, doing so at the end of the Post-Enies Lobby Arc. [Chapter 439] Franky was born in the South Blue [Chapter 490] to Scien, an infamous scientist and pirate who would later be known as Queen of the Beasts Pirates. It is also worth noting that Franky's original transformation into BF-36 was initiated as a quasi-surgical operation of necessity to save his life, and it is assumed it was accomplished with some modicum of haste from a medical standpoint, since he suffered from massive external and internal injuries, whereas the process to become BF-37 was a two-year-long planned process done with highly advanced machinery in an abandoned, fully stocked scientific laboratory on his preexisting cyborg…
capability_summary.defense_durability: Due to the bionic modifications done to his body, Franky has incredible superhuman strength. His years of being a ship dismantler, as well as a bounty hunter prior to becoming a pirate, seem to have further contributed greatly to his formidable physical prowess; even when running low on cola, he exhibits enough strength to overwhelm a charging, fully grown elephant, stopping it in its tracks before dragging it around by the trunk like it was a rag doll and smashing it into the ground with tremendous force. When first confronted by the CP9 members in Water 7, Franky was shown to be strong enough to almost break through Blueno's Tekkai and quickly overpower him in terms of brute force. [Chapter 352] Franky was even able to briefly fight on par against Luffy during their initial confrontation, before their fight was interrupted by the Galley-La Company workers.

capability_summary.offense: Even for a fish-man, Jinbe possesses tremendous strength. Alongside Jack, he is one of the most powerful fish-men seen thus far, shown when he punched a giant fish-man up into the air, [Chapter 646] defeated a Super Rookie with one punch, caught a gigantic iron club with one hand, [Chapter 990] held up a falling ceiling, [Chapter 1038] and grappled with Big Mom, an Emperor of the Sea who possesses tremendous strength and weight, easily throwing her over his shoulder. [Chapter 989] He easily defeated Charlotte Opera with just one punch. He managed to defeat Who's-Who, a member of the Beasts Pirates' Tobiroppo and a former CP9 agent whose strength is stated to rival Rob Lucci.

[Chapter 578] Oddly enough, he exclaimed in pain when bitten by Luffy, though this is most likely because he was prepared for Akainu's attack but was caught off guard by Luffy's bite and that it was more out of irritation than actual damage. Furthermore, Law has to concentrate in order to maintain and use his power, and unlike most Devil Fruit powers, Law's powers directly take a toll on his stamina. [Chapter 710] Inside the aura sphere, Law can exert complete control over the fabric of space, referred to as the ability to "operate" on anything within the spherical "operating room"; he can move things within the area of the sphere telekinetically and make things, including himself and other people, swap locations via…

In addition, he was also capable of enduring a prolonged brutal beating from Vergo which resulted in him becoming severely bloody before defeating him in a single blow once Smoker had retrieved his heart. Even as a child dying from the incurable Amber Lead Syndrome, Law was able to endure Rosinante throwing him from the top of a tall building into a pile of junk, as well as keep up with the very harsh training regimen of the Donquixote Pirates of which even adults could not keep up with.

capability_summary.offense: *: From above, Drake swings his sword to his right and his axe to his left, striking down upon an enemy with both weapons simultaneously. capability_summary.offense: Through an unknown method, Teach became the first and, so far, only known person to wield the powers of two Devil Fruits at the same time. Marco speculated that this was possible due to an unstated peculiarity unique to Teach himself, having to do with an "atypical body structure" of some sort. capability_summary.defense_durability: Teach has an immense amount of superhuman resistance and durability. During his fight with Ace, he was engulfed in flames and pierced in the chest by two fire spears, but after putting out the flames, he was able to shake off the impact of the attacks. Another indication of his sheer durability is shown when he took a Jet Pistol from an enraged Luffy, [Chapter 544] and was hit by one of Sengoku's shockwaves in his Daibutsu form only to come out with minor injuries both times. [Chapter 578] Even more monstrous, is his incredible endurance, with even extremely powerful and potent attacks never succeeding at keeping him down for long - all despite his Devil Fruit greatly amplifying the pain which he receives.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Armament Haki
demonstrated_abilities.description: Kaidou is an immensely skilled user of Armament Haki, which he is capable of imbuing into his kanabō. During the Raid on Onigashima, similarly to Katakuri, his Armament Haki was strong enough to damage Luffy, who hardened both of his arms. [Chapter 1009] He is capable of utilizing the advanced application of this type of Haki, projecting his Armament Haki out from his kanabō, allowing him to strike opponents many meters in front of him with devastating power without the need to make direct contact, [Chapter 1009] [Chapter 1024] and the attack power can be increased further if the kanabō is imbued with Supreme King Haki. In the anime, when Kaidou uses advanced Armament Haki, it is shown as a purple-colored flowing aura.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Physical Abilities
demonstrated_abilities.description: Even without his Zoan-type Devil Fruit powers, Kaidou is legendary for his supreme physical power as the world's "Strongest Creature". With a one-handed swing of his kanabō, he can send normal-sized people flying into the distance, and he broke past the tremendous defensive power of Luffy's Gear 4 with great ease. He once sank nine enormous prison ships singlehandedly. [Chapter 795] Sengoku once said that even as a mere apprentice in the Rocks Pirates, Kaidou was able to earn the respect of his vicious companions through his strength alone.

weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: Kaidou wields a large, black, spiked kanabō named Hassaikai as his signature weapon, which he already possessed during his apprentice days in the Rocks Pirates. When Kaidou killed Oden, he used a pistol to shoot Oden in the head. [Chapter 972]

demonstrated_abilities.name: Buggy Balls and Muggy Balls

With this ammunition, he can terrorize a village that is not well protected such as Orange Town and easily destroy it whenever he wants. Additionally, he has also fired Buggy Balls at people who come to his base to confront him or subordinates that displease him, bringing certain death upon them. [Chapter 10] However, his crewmates have shown to be able to survive after being hit.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Live-Action Differences
demonstrated_abilities.description: In the live-action series, Buggy is depicted as having taken Orange Town's citizens as a captive audience in a large circus tent rather than forcing them to flee. He has also destroyed the town rather leaving it mostly undamaged. Buggy also is searching for the Grand Line map and captures the Straw Hat Pirates after learning they stole it from the 153rd Branch.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Adaptation Differences / Live-Action Differences' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Translation and Dub Issues
demonstrated_abilities.description: Under the 4Kids-dubbed anime, Buggy received typical content edits: his crew's alcohol was censored into "grapefruit punch", blood was erased from his successful knifings, and Luffy's kick to his groin was redrawn as a kick to his shin. A "reverb" effect was also used whenever he spoke in anger, implying that his powers could "split" even his voice. When Buggy mocked Luffy for proclaiming that he would become the next king of pirates, he sarcastically stated that he would be the "emperor" in comparison instead of "God" like in the original.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Supreme King Haki
demonstrated_abilities.description: Roger possessed immense mastery in the usage of Supreme King Haki, which was seen when he clashed with fellow Supreme King Haki user Edward Newgate. Their clash created a notable effect similar to lightning and released a large burst that traveled across the island that they were on and split the heavens, pushing back the Moby Dick alongside the nearby trees, clouds, and people. [Chapter 1027] Most notably, Roger was one of the very few Supreme King users able to use the advanced application to "infuse" his attacks with Supreme King Haki to exponentially increase his attack power, with his sword being shown emitting streams of black lightning-like energy in his clash with Edward Newgate, signifying the infusion. [Chapter 1010]

Roger also had immense levels of endurance and vitality, even when his body was ravaged by an incurable disease.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Silvers Rayleigh, also known as the "Dark King", is a legendary retired pirate who served as the first mate of the former Roger Pirates, known as the "Right Hand of the Pirate King". He is one of the major figures from the time when Gol D. Roger, the "Pirate King", was still alive.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Silvers Rayleigh, also known as the "Dark King", is a legendary retired pirate who served as the first mate of the former Roger Pirates, known as the "Right Hand of the Pirate King". He is one of the major figures from the time when Gol D. Roger, the "Pirate King", was still alive.
capability_summary.offense: Rayleigh is a tremendously skilled and powerful swordsman with decades of combat experience since his time with the Roger Pirates. He was able to fight on equal grounds with Admiral Kizaru, who himself is a highly skilled swordsman when wielding his Ama no Murakumo, and managed to cut and draw blood from the admiral's face by combining Armament Haki with his swordsmanship. This is even more impressive given that Rayleigh has not used his sword in quite a while due to being retired. [Chapter 512] He can also create powerful compressed air slashes, as shown when he cut the ground to prevent Marines from chasing after Luffy. [Chapter 602]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Rayleigh possesses immense physical strength despite his elderly age. He was capable of killing several Sea Kings with his bare hands even after swimming to Amazon Lily from outside the Calm Belt. [Chapter 591] In the anime, he could throw bullets with extreme force and accuracy to destroy cannonballs fired at him. Rayleigh is extremely fast and possesses extraordinary reflexes.
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Rayleigh possesses immense physical strength despite his elderly age. He was capable of killing several Sea Kings with his bare hands even after swimming to Amazon Lily from outside the Calm Belt. [Chapter 591] In the anime, he could throw bullets with extreme force and accuracy to destroy cannonballs fired at him. Rayleigh is extremely fast and possesses extraordinary reflexes.
capability_summary.leadership: Rayleigh possesses immense mastery in the usage of Supreme King Haki, a rare form of Haki that only one in several million people in the world can use. His level of skill is enough to render a specific target or entire crowds completely unconscious, as shown when he knocked out Rosward Shalria before disabling an entire hall room full of hostiles. [Chapter 503] Rayleigh's Supreme King Haki was at least twice as potent as Luffy's by the time of the Fish-Man Island Arc; Rayleigh could have knocked out all 100,000 of the New Fish-Man Pirates opposing the Straw Hats, whereas Luffy overwhelmed only half that. Most notably, he is among the small "handful" of users who are capable of using the advanced application of this type of Haki, able to "infuse" his body or objects with Supreme King Haki to increase his attack power, signified by thin streams of black lightning emanating from his body.
capability_summary.tactics: Rayleigh is a master of Observation Haki. He could sense that there were five hundred creatures on Rusukaina who were stronger than Luffy before his training had begun and used it to dodge an elephant's attack with his eyes closed. When he arrived at Amazon Lily, Rayleigh was able to sense that Luffy was on the island. [Chapter 591] He also has knowledge of the advanced application of this type of Haki and how high-level users can see into the future. [Chapter 894]

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Dracule "Hawk Eyes" Mihawk is a world-famous pirate currently recognized as the strongest swordsman in the world. Known as the "Marine Hunter" in his early career, Mihawk stood as one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea (the first to be revealed and formally introduced) until the group's dissolution, and was for a time the sole human resident of Kuraigana Island. Since then, he has become a founding executive of the Cross Guild, alongside fellow ex-Warlord Crocodile. [Chapter 1058]

Mihawk's swordsmanship is extremely versatile; he can create immensely powerful compressed air slashes that are able to destroy gigantic ships and enormous icebergs from great distances [Chapter 561] by using the "Strong Blade" swordsmanship, and can deflect the course of bullets with masterful and graceful precision [Chapter 50] using the "Gentle Blade" swordsmanship.

demonstrated_abilities.description: Per standard content policies, the 4Kids-dubbed anime censors any blood Mihawk draws, particularly his finishing slash on Zoro; both of his blades are also censored to appear less cross-like, with Yoru's guard heavily shortened and Kogatana's erased entirely. weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: Mihawk wields one of the 12 Supreme Grade Blades, the "Black Blade" Yoru, as his main weapon. Yoru is a curved, single-edged black blade in the shape of a Latin cross, with a golden crossguard decorated by red cabochons (which are blue and green in the anime) and a hilt wrapped in bandages, with a particularly big cabochon at its extremity. When he accepts challenges for his title, he only draws this blade for those with enough spirit to earn Mihawk's respect or enough power to present a threat; otherwise, his Kogatana is sufficient.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Donquixote Doflamingo, nicknamed "Heavenly Yaksha", is the captain of the Donquixote Pirates. [Chapter 692] Before his imprisonment, [Chapter 801] he was a member of the Seven Warlords of the Sea with a frozen bounty of 340,000,000, [Chapter 234] as well as the most influential underworld broker under the codename "Joker". He is also a former World Noble, descended from the Donquixote Family. He is the first son of the late Donquixote Homing [Chapter 763] and the older brother of the late Rosinante, [Chapter 749] both of whom he killed out of feeling betrayed by them. [Chapter 747] Doflamingo became the King of Dressrosa after taking the throne from Riku Doldo III eight years before the start of the series. [Chapter 721] He ruled the country tyrannically until he was stripped of his positions as a Warlord of the Sea and king after he was defeated by Monkey D.

[Chapter 747] Doflamingo became the King of Dressrosa after taking the throne from Riku Doldo III eight years before the start of the series. [Chapter 721] He ruled the country tyrannically until he was stripped of his positions as a Warlord of the Sea and king after he was defeated by Monkey D.
capability_summary.offense: Doflamingo has tremendous physical might; his great leg strength allowed him to produce a 360° razor-sharp shockwave, which was powerful enough to instantly cut through all three towers of Dressrosa's royal palace in one swing, similar to Kaku's Rankyaku: Amane Dachi but using only one leg and without the preparatory spinning. [Chapter 745] He also showed enough strength to equally clash against Crocodile's hook with just a kick (their clash created a shock wave strong enough to push nearby Marines away). [Chapter 566] He blocked a Diable Jambe-enhanced kick from Sanji with his knee and defended against the subsequent barrage of kicks that followed with his arm without difficulty, an impressive feat since Sanji's kicks can effortlessly break through buildings, users of Tekkai, and even the stronger-than-steel body of a Pacifista. [Chapter 724] He even managed to give Luffy a…
capability_summary.defense_durability: Doflamingo possesses a monstrous amount of resistance, durability, pain tolerance, and stamina. A testament to this is that over the course of the series until the Dressrosa Arc, he had never been injured or shown exhaustion by any other character during a battle. [Chapter 729] This is noteworthy, as he was present in the war between the Marines and Whitebeard Pirates, a battle in which most of the series' strongest individuals, such as Sengoku, were in some way injured. Even as an 8-year-old—freshly out of the inner circle of the Celestial Dragons and therefore still physically weak from being pampered—he survived the various tortures the mob put him through, never breaking in nor begging, and instead swore revenge.
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Doflamingo possesses tremendous speed, agility, and reflexes. He was able to dodge Oars Jr.'s attacks with relative ease and completely jumped over Oars Jr.'s gigantic body. [Chapter 555] He was fast enough to escape through the eye of Crocodile's sandstorm and exit unscathed. [Chapter 561] He is incredibly swift, being able to avoid Luffy's Gear 2 attacks by quickly disappearing from view. [Chapter 780]
capability_summary.leadership: Doflamingo possesses the ability to use Supreme King Haki, a rare form of Haki that only one in several million people in the world can use. Doflamingo's Supreme King Haki first awakened when he was around ten years old, when being pursued again by North Blue citizens who tried to continuously torture his family in revenge, knocking them all out, thus saving him. [Chapter 767] He would eventually gain control over it, as shown when he knocked out the majority of the G-5 Marines at Punk Hazard decades later. [Chapter 698] In a clash with Luffy, their Haki created a notable effect similar to lightning. [Chapter 782]
capability_summary.tactics: He is well-versed in psychological warfare, as he prepared to use the Mera Mera no Mi as bait to break apart the alliance between Luffy and Law, believing that Luffy would never allow anyone else to have it. True enough, after learning of the fruit being offered as the grand prize at the Corrida Colosseum, Luffy immediately entered himself into the contest to try to win it. This displays great insight from Doflamingo towards other people.

During the first half of the series, he was one of the three admirals, and was the last one out of the three to debut. [Chapter 550] Upon becoming the Fleet Admiral, one of Sakazuki's first decisions was to relocate Marine Headquarters into the New World in preparation for the New Pirate Age. [Chapter 598] Sakazuki is one of the most strident followers of Absolute Justice in the Marines, to the point where his extremism prompted his fellow admiral Aokiji to oppose his promotion to Fleet Admiral and resign from the Marines after this effort failed. In the manga, he was first mentioned by Nico Robin during the initial encounter with Aokiji.

capability_summary.offense: Kuzan ate the Hie Hie no Mi, a Logia-type Devil Fruit [Chapter 319] that allows him to create, control, and transform his body into ice. Compared to most Logia users who, when transformed, can let physical attacks pass through their "fluid" bodies, Kuzan is more easily hit since ice is a solid element. However, he still goes unharmed by enemy attacks that are not infused with Haki; instead of dissipating out of harm's way, his body shatters apart when struck, only to reform as effortlessly as any Logia user thereafter. [Chapter 553] Kuzan is able to form constructs out of ice.
capability_summary.defense_durability: Kuzan's physical prowess is immense, befitting his former Admiral position. His strength is particularly notable, having developed massive punching power from years of training under Garp since his early marine days. Like his mentor, Kuzan would use retired battleships like sandbags ("battleship bags") to train up the force of his punches, while not permitting himself to use his Devil Fruit powers or Haki; ultimately, Kuzan reached a point where, like Garp himself, he could cave in the armored hulls of ships with the sheer force of his blows.

He could also withstand a kick from Doflamingo without issue using his sword.

capability_summary.offense: Yamato is an immensely skilled user of Supreme King Haki, a very rare form of Haki whose users are said to have the qualities of a "king". It was first awakened 20 years ago as a result of Yamato running wild throughout Onigashima as a child, knocking out Kaidou's subordinates. As an adult, Yamato demonstrated its advanced application of "infusion", something that only a "handful" of people can do, often imbuing his weapon Takeru and causing a stream of black lightning to be emitted from it, as shown when performing Raimei Hakke and Shinsoku Hakujaku. [Chapter 1024] [Chapter 1025] Yamato's advanced Supreme King was also strong enough to hurt the Admiral Ryokugyu. [Chapter 1054]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Yamato is an extremely skilled user of Armament Haki, as shown by facing off against Ace, a Logia user and clashing against his flames, managing to wound him. Two years later, Yamato was shown projecting a long-distance swing using a hardened Takeru that knocked out Hatcha. [Chapter 996] Yamato's Armament Haki is strong enough to wound Kaidou whose skin is impervious to all but the strongest Haki attacks.
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Yamato possesses immense physical strength resembling that of Kaidou, being capable of wielding a large and heavy kanabo and using it to knock out Ulti, an Ancient Zoan user and one of the Tobiroppo known for her durable skull with just one blow in the head. weapons_and_equipment.description: Yamato wields a giant kanabō named Takeru, which is much like Kaidou's club Hassaikai, though it is studded and more slender while Hassaikai is spiked and slightly thicker. Yamato has mastered the usage of his kanabo despite its great size and weight, being capable of moving it to counter Luffy's rapid attacks with little effort.

demonstrated_abilities.description: Oden was among the very small number of people in the world who could use all three types of Haki. In Wano, he, in particular, was stronger among their Samurai, as he could easily wield Enma, a Famous Blade that drains its user's Haki to a near-fatal level from childhood. His father, Kouzuki Sukiyaki, complimented that no one other than Oden could tame Enma, leaving Zoro in awe, who wondered how he could wield it, despite how much Haki was drained from him, treating it as if it were as light as a feather.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Armament Haki
demonstrated_abilities.description: Oden was an immensely powerful master of Armament Haki, known as "Ryuo" in Wano. He is noted as being the sole samurai to tame the Famous Blade, Enma, infamous for its gluttonous Haki-draining properties, which even Kin'emon, the Nine Red Scabbards' fearless leader, was afraid of wielding. [Chapter 955] As a testament to this, Oden's mastery was superior to that of Roronoa Zoro, a powerful swordsman and Armament Haki user, who had his entire arm emaciated the first time but managed to regain the absorbed Haki. It was such that during Enma testing, Zoro couldn't satiate it without going all out, acknowledging that he was lacking compared to Oden. [Chapter 1033] Even at age 18, Oden was masterful in using Ryuo, as he imbued both of his swords, hardening them and letting him cleanly bisect the enormous Mountain God with one slash.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: "Foxfire" Kin'emon is a samurai from the region of Kuri in Wano Country who currently serves the shogunate as a great elder in the Flower Capital. Once a thug in his youth, [Chapter 960] he became a retainer of the Kouzuki Family and the leader of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. He was born 56 years before the present day, but traveled 20 years forward in time when he was 36 years old.

capability_summary.offense: As the leader of the Nine Red Scabbards of Kouzuki Oden, Kin'emon is one of the most powerful samurai of Wano, noted by Orochi himself to be an incredibly strong master in swordsmanship. His skills are extremely versatile, able to wield either one or dual wield both his swords with incredible power and precision. Even after getting dismembered into several body parts by the Ope Ope no Mi, Kin'emon was capable of putting up a fight with his legs, recklessly attacking Luffy's party when they encountered him.
capability_summary.defense_durability: Kin'emon is an extremely skilled user of Armament Haki, known in Wano as "Ryuo". [Chapter 788] His Armament Haki is strong enough to withstand the Birdcage's razor sharp threads, which can slice cannon balls and meteorites with ease. When fueled by rage, his Haki-infused sword was able to pierce Kaidou's nigh-invulnerable body. [Chapter 987]
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Kin'emon has an extreme amount of superhuman strength, to the point that cutting through thick steel is a trivial task for him. Towards the end of the Dressrosa Arc, Kin'emon helped slow down the contraction speed of Doflamingo's Birdcage by pushing against it with his Haki-infused swords. At age 15, Kin'emon challenged the gigantic boar known as the Mountain God, survived its violent rampage, and injured it with his katana, making it bleed.
capability_summary.leadership: unknown: no demonstrated leadership in the inspected source.
capability_summary.tactics: Noted by Orochi for his tactical intellect, Kin'emon is an extremely clever tactician, having been the one to formulate most of the strategies behind the alliance's revolution against the Emperor Kaidou. At Dressrosa, Kin'emon was the one who up with the idea of disguising Zoro, Luffy, and himself as toys with animal costumes to get away from the Marines without drawing attention. Kin'emon was also smart enough to disguise himself as Donquixote Doflamingo while searching through the Dressrosa Royal Palace, allowing him to trick Gladius without the latter suspecting him of being an intruder. [Chapter 740] At Onigashima, Kin'emon would employ similar tactics, camouflaging the members of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance in uniforms of the Beasts Pirates, allowing them to better infiltrate Kaidou's domain and assimilate among his forces while remaining undetected until the time of…

capability_summary.conditional_abilities: Devil Fruit: Kin'emon ate the Fuku Fuku no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows him to transform small objects placed on a person's head, such as pebbles and leaves, into various articles of clothing. [Chapter 663] He must first visualize the appearance of the clothes, otherwise his creations are limited. While this power lacks direct combat applications, it does have a number of support functions; he can provide quick disguises for himself and his allies, letting them move around enemy territory undetected.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Kikunojo of the Lingering Snow, more commonly referred to as Kiku, is a samurai from Wano Country and a retainer for the Kouzuki Family, serving as one of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. She is also the younger sister of Izou and the daughter of the dancing school head of the Hanayanagi School in Ringo. [Chapter 962] After traveling forward in time, she worked as a tea house poster girl in Okobore Town while gathering information for the planned rebellion. She participated in the Raid on Onigashima where she battled Kaidou alongside the other Scabbards, losing her left arm to one of Kaidou's attacks. [Chapter 993] Following Kouzuki Momonosuke's ascent to shogun, she serves as the daimyo of Ringo.

capability_summary.offense: As a samurai and a member of the Nine Red Scabbards, Kikunojo is an extremely skilled swordswoman [Chapter 914] whose strength was acknowledged by Kurozumi Orochi himself. Specializing in the Gentle Blade swordsmanship, Kikunojo was capable of swiftly cutting off Urashima's topknot and fought against several Gifters and samurai effortlessly. She compares her swordsmanship to snow that lingers in the spring, saying the wounds it inflicts will remain with its victims in the afterlife. [Chapter 985] In Pirate Warriors 4, some of Kikunojo's strikes have a freezing effect on the opponent, which fits her epithet.
capability_summary.defense_durability: True to her large size, Kiku has immense strength, able to apply enough strength in her swordsmanship to perform powerful flying slashes. She is extremely fast and agile, able to easily evade Urashima's attempt embrace as well as sprinting towards Kurozumi Kanjuro instantly while wearing a full set of armor. She has extraordinary endurance, able to withstand having her arm amputated, followed by the cauterization of the wound, while exhibiting only mild discomfort, and quickly rejoined the Nine Red Scabbards in battling against Kaidou.

He can make the scrolls grow to a massive size and unroll as long as he pleases. Raizo also has the ability to seal and store objects inside them and later release them.

[Chapter 818] Despite his size, he is extremely fast, being capable of leaping off the walls of the Executive Tower in Udon too rapidly for any of the guards to keep up with. Additionally, he is fast enough to be able to hide with only the assistance of a smoke ball, even in large, crowded spaces. He has enough endurance that after recovering in a short time from battling Kaidou, Raizo was able to function normally.

During the Raid on Onigashima, he wielded two swords which he used during the ambush of Kaidou [Chapter 986].

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Charlotte Katakuri is the second son and third child of the Charlotte Family and the elder triplet brother of Daifuku and Oven. He is also one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Flour, governing over Komugi Island. Due to his actions and role, Katakuri is the secondary antagonist in the second half of the Whole Cake Island Arc.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Charlotte Katakuri is the second son and third child of the Charlotte Family and the elder triplet brother of Daifuku and Oven. He is also one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Flour, governing over Komugi Island. Due to his actions and role, Katakuri is the secondary antagonist in the second half of the Whole Cake Island Arc.
capability_summary.offense: Katakuri is an extremely skilled user of Armament Haki as shown when he hardened his mochi leg in order to bludgeon and injure Monkey D. Luffy. His Haki enhanced strikes are powerful enough to counter and overpower Luffy's own Haki enhanced attacks, and he has boasted that his Armament Haki is superior to Luffy's. [Chapter 883] When performing his Zan Giri Mochi attack, Katakuri's Haki becomes flame-shaped, like Big Mom's Haki and Luffy's Haki when he uses Gear 4 and the luster of it is blue. [Chapter 895]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Noted to be the strongest of the Three Sweet Commanders, Katakuri possesses immense physical strength, being able to flick jellybeans with such extreme force and velocity that they act like bullets, mortally wounding his opponents with a single shot. [Chapter 869] Even from a great distance, Katakuri can kill a man with a flicked jellybean. He was also able to defeat Vinsmoke Ichiji, a genetically enhanced Germa 66 commander who was wearing his Raid Suit, with minimal effort and without incurring any injuries himself. Katakuri is an extremely skilled and powerful hand-to-hand combatant.

Katakuri is an extremely skilled and powerful hand-to-hand combatant.
capability_summary.leadership: Katakuri possessed the ability to use Supreme King Haki, a rare form of Haki that only one in several million people in the world can use. He is a capable user of it as shown when he released a large burst alongside Monkey D. Luffy's own Supreme King Haki in order to knock out Charlotte Flampe and her subordinates as punishment for their interruption.
capability_summary.tactics: Katakuri has extraordinary mastery of Observation Haki, specifically its advanced form of "Future Vision" that allows him to see (as well as listen) a few seconds ahead into the future. He was able to detect and instantly thwart an assassination attempt on Big Mom and her affiliates that would have been carried out moments later by a vengeful Tea Party invitee; his predictions were shown to be accurate when Katakuri justified his killing of the guest to Capone Bege and knew word for word how the latter would respond to him. He would later repeat this capacity during his one-on-one battle against Monkey D.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Devil Fruit
demonstrated_abilities.description: Katakuri ate the Mochi Mochi no Mi, a Special Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that lets him create, control and transform his body into mochi at will. His mochi is extremely thick and adhesive, allowing him to trap even extremely strong enemies with it, although it loses its effectiveness when exposed to liquids. He frequently uses these abilities in hand-to-hand combat, sprouting several tendrils of mochi on his body to act as extra fists or legs; he can imbue these tendrils with Armament Haki to deliver extremely hard punches and kicks. [Chapter 879] He is also able to enlarge his mochi limbs to gigantic size and stretch them to increase his attack range.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: Charlotte Smoothie [Chapter 888] is the 14th daughter and 35th child of the Charlotte Family, the older triplet sister of Citron and Cinnamon, and a longleg-human hybrid. She serves as one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and as Totto Land's Minister of Juice, governing over 100% Island. Due to her actions and role, she is a major antagonist in the Whole Cake Island Arc.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: Charlotte Smoothie [Chapter 888] is the 14th daughter and 35th child of the Charlotte Family, the older triplet sister of Citron and Cinnamon, and a longleg-human hybrid. She serves as one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and as Totto Land's Minister of Juice, governing over 100% Island. Due to her actions and role, she is a major antagonist in the Whole Cake Island Arc.
capability_summary.offense: Smoothie ate the Shibo Shibo no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows her to drain liquid from both living and non-living things. She uses her power by twisting her target and wringing it out like a soaked cloth, though she can also drain liquid from a target by cutting it with her sword. She can squeeze the liquid out of anything, including animals, people, and even substances that would normally be too dangerous to touch, such as lava.
capability_summary.defense_durability: Smoothie possesses an extremely high level of physical strength befitting her size, being able to pick up, with one hand, and with both hands squeeze out a normal-sized person using her ability with little effort. She also managed to squeeze a giraffe in a similar fashion with one grip. The anime shows her possessing enough strength to send Vinsmoke Reiju flying back, and having a strong enough grip to stop Nami from wriggling or moving in her hand.

capability_summary.leadership: Smoothie seems to hold Baron Tamago in high regards as she seeks and listens to his advice in spite of holding higher authority within the crew. Later when she failed to capture Brook, she reported to Tamago right away and apologized for failing.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Fire Tank Pirates
demonstrated_abilities.description: They once served under Big Mom's crew and were seemingly loyal. However, when Bege revealed his treachery, he attempted to kill Big Mom as an incapacitated Smoothie was helpless to watch and wanted to stop them. [Chapter 865] When his assassination plot failed, she and her crew were able to regain their composure and move in on him and his allies in response to his treachery. [Chapter 868] After Bege transformed into his Big Father form and his allies retreated into his fortress, Smoothie announced her intention to torture them for underestimating her crew. When her crew managed to route their enemies, they prepared to execute them until the Whole Cake Chateau collapsed, allowing her enemies to escape as Bege mocked them in the process. [Chapter 872] Once the crew recovered, Smoothie swore to her mother that she would not allow their enemies to escape alive. [Chapter 872]
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Relationship / Enemies / Fire Tank Pirates' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Vinsmoke Family
demonstrated_abilities.description: Since Smoothie participated in her mother's plot to assassinate the Vinsmoke Family, Smoothie is an enemy of that family. Reiju kicked Smoothie on her arm, causing her to drop Nami, and Smoothie remarks Reiju's poison abilities to be "some trouble". Later as the Vinsmoke Family fought against the Big Mom Pirates, Smoothie managed to overpower Reiju but failed to kill her after the Tamatebako exploded and caused the Whole Cake Chateau to collapse. [Chapter 871]

weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: Smoothie carries a large sword on her back, with its sheath shaped like a drill bit. She can combine it with her Devil Fruit ability to drain liquid from any opponents she cuts with it and absorb liquid into it to increase its size and then unleash it as massive flying blasts. She has shown to possess considerable swordsmanship skills, using it to deflect cannon fire. [Chapter 930] The anime shows her possessing enough skill to clash with Vinsmoke Ichiji and Reiju.

capability_summary.combat_effectiveness: "Thousand Arms" Charlotte Cracker [Chapter 838] is the tenth son and 15th child of the Charlotte Family and the oldest triplet brother of Custard and Angel. He is also one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Biscuits, governing Biscuits Island. Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the first half of the Whole Cake Island Arc.
capability_summary.significant_achievements: "Thousand Arms" Charlotte Cracker [Chapter 838] is the tenth son and 15th child of the Charlotte Family and the oldest triplet brother of Custard and Angel. He is also one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Biscuits, governing Biscuits Island. Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the first half of the Whole Cake Island Arc.
capability_summary.offense: Cracker wields a huge double-edged sword named Pretzel, which is one of the Famous Blades and is larger than himself with a crossguard shaped like a biscuit. [Chapter 838] He claims that it is a unique sword which has no peers. [Chapter 837] Cracker's Biscuit Soldiers each wield one or more much larger replicas of Pretzel made out of biscuit. [Chapter 838] He can also create biscuit shields with his Devil Fruit. [Chapter 836] Cracker is extremely skilled in wielding Pretzel, as he can attack very quickly despite the sword's size. Combined with Armament Haki, he was able to cut through Luffy’s Gear 4-enhanced Haki defenses with his sword. [Chapter 838]
capability_summary.defense_durability: Cracker has extraordinarily powerful Armament Haki, which he uses to harden his sword(s) and biscuit armor. Defensively, it allowed him to easily repel Luffy's own Haki-imbued Gear 2 and Third attacks, causing the latter to remark on its incredible toughness. Offensively, it strengthened his sword enough to let him cut near-halfway through Luffy's Haki-imbued arm in Gear 4 [Chapter 838] (a notable feat, as even Doflamingo had previously shown inability to harm Luffy's Gear 4 form). [Chapter 784]
capability_summary.speed_mobility: Cracker has also shown immense amounts of stamina, being able to fight and chase after Luffy for eleven hours. [Chapter 841] He has extraordinary strength, able to wield Pretzel, a very large sword, while maintaining sufficient speed to keep up with Luffy. In the anime, he is shown being able to clash evenly with Luffy, who was in Gear 4, and pushing him back with Pretzel.

capability_summary.offense: King ate the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Pteranodon, an Ancient Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows him to transform into a full pteranodon and a lunarian-pteranodon hybrid at will. When transformed, he is more clad in flames than usual and gains the ability to fly at extreme speeds. As with dinosaur-based Zoans, King's pterosaur form greatly bolsters his physical abilities, including his naturally impressive durability, and he can use his strong wings as a shield to defend from powerful attacks without sustaining injury. [Chapter 1032] King's full Beast Form is strong enough to either violently push back or inflict significant damage upon whatever he flies into, be it people or massive objects, like an entire ship.

His fighting style is a wild one, eschewing proper form and technique in favor of a savage yet practical mixture of swordplay, hand-to-hand combat, his Zoan transformation, and a lunarian's natural ability to emit fire. He has been seen disarming opponents with his swordbreaker-like katana to leave them vulnerable to follow-up attacks, while generally pairing punches and kicks with strokes of his sword. [Chapter 1023] [Chapter 1035] As a swordsman in particular, King has proven himself skilled enough to keep up with Zoro's powerful and versatile three-bladed fighting style, matching him blow for blow and overpowering him at certain points via brute force. [Chapter 1032] [Chapter 1035] King boasts massive physical strength.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Fire Manipulation
demonstrated_abilities.description: As a lunarian, King has the innate ability to "ignite" any part of his body, allowing him to create and control fire in both his base and Zoan forms; it is this ability that garnered King his epithet "the Conflagration". Whether excessive use of his flames causes King any kind of drawback is unknown, but at least those flames on his back are directly linked to his tremendous resilience as a lunarian: when they go out, King's bodily defense weakens considerably in exchange for a boost to his movement speed. Using the fire he conjures, King can boost his melee attacks, like throwing a flaming punch, kicking with a flaming leg to burn his foe, or coating his sword in fire.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Abilities and Powers / Fire Manipulation' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Attacks
demonstrated_abilities.description: *: King conjures a fireball over his open palm, then forms a fist to execute a powerful flame-clad punch. The attack was first seen when King tried to strike (a then-disabled) Zoro, but Marco came in to block the punch. The attack's name comes from , a type of traditional Japanese lantern consisting of an oil lamp housed in a paper-covered, wooden stand; like King's other attacks, this one's name ends with -don.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Early Concepts
demonstrated_abilities.description: King's Vivre Card entry revealed two earlier design concepts for the character: one where he looks mostly like his current self, save for his wings being leathery and bat-like as opposed to feathered, and another where King looks more drastically different, having a very top-heavy build and a pronounced hunchback, a cape rather than wings, prominent horns, and what looks like overalls (while seemingly retaining a flame on his back and a sword). weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: King carries a large katana on his right hip, befitting his size. It sports a plain-round, golden tsuba, a matching gold kashira and kojiri, and tsuka-ito of dark-orange color forming traditional rhombus gaps to expose the lighter-orange hilt underlay. It is sheathed in a saya of the same orange as the ito, which has two red cords with hanging, tufted ends below its mouth, plus additional red bands around the lower parts of the saya.

demonstrated_abilities.description: Being a legendary warrior of the Corrida Coliseum who won 3000 matches, Kyros is an extremely powerful swordsman. His sword skills are of the highest caliber, as he could defeat all of his opponents in the Coliseum matches, including a fish-man underwater and even a giant, using only a blunt sword. He could accurately deflect numerous steel balls that rained down on him by Diamante.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Abilities and Powers / Swordsmanship' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Swordsmanship — Techniques
demonstrated_abilities.description: *: Kyros jumps and slashes his opponent with his sword with extraordinary force, similar to a lightning strike. This attack was first used against Diamante, which was powerful enough to simultaneously cut through his rapier and also grievously wound him in one strike. Trueno Bastardo is Spanish for "Bastard Thunder"; the Japanese pronunciation of Spanish Bastardo is the same as English "Bastard", a term from how a longsword is referred to as a "bastard sword".
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Abilities and Powers / Swordsmanship / Techniques' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Tactical Skills
demonstrated_abilities.description: Kyros is also a skilled tactician, having been the one to formulate Operation SOP, a daring plan that exploited both the Donquixote regime's tyrannical nature and weak links within their enemies' own ranks, particularly Sugar. Despite numerous setbacks, it would be effective and instrumental in overthrowing Doflamingo by completely breaking the Donquixote Pirates' control over Dressrosa after liberating the countless numbers of victims Sugar had enslaved with her Devil Fruit powers.
demonstrated_abilities.evidence: Deterministic extract from section 'Abilities and Powers / Tactical Skills' of the inspected ability profile.

demonstrated_abilities.name: Toy Abilities
demonstrated_abilities.description: As a toy, he seems to be rather fast and evasive, as he managed to elude the police pursuing him every time, even with one leg. He was able to fight numerous dangers in the past and was a great teacher to Rebecca, as he trained her to be a formidable warrior, fighting without getting hurt or hurting her opponents. However, as his body is a mere toy, it is weak in durability, and as time went by, he continued to break down, with his joints already creaking. [Chapter 733] His weakened form made him less capable at physically fighting people compared to his human form, however, as he was quickly overwhelmed in hand-to-hand combat by Lao G, and since he was made of inorganic matter, he was susceptible to being ruptured by Gladius' Pamu Pamu no Mi.

weapons_and_equipment.name: Weapons
weapons_and_equipment.description: At age 15, Kyros wielded a makeshift mace made from a pipe with nails sticking out of it. During his time as a gladiator, he wielded a blunted sword. He later switched to a sharpened bastard sword when he became captain of the guard.
